name: Soft
prompt: Keep the performance gentle, restrained, and non-confrontational.

name: Controlled
prompt: Maintain quiet confidence with occasional sharp accents rather than constant force.

name: Strong
prompt: Use assertive delivery, firm rhythm, and clear confrontational energy.

name: Maximum Impact
prompt: Push maximum controlled aggression, hard entrances, decisive punchlines, and explosive hook energy.

name: Escalating
prompt: Begin calm and controlled, then increase aggression section by section toward the final chorus.

name: None
prompt: Keep the voice calm and non-confrontational with soft drum impact and no aggressive lyrical posture.

name: Gentle
prompt: Use warm restrained delivery and rounded dynamics with only light emphasis at emotional turns.

name: Low Simmer
prompt: Hold controlled tension under the surface with clipped accents and one or two sharper peaks.

name: Moderate
prompt: Balance steady confident force with breathing room; verses stay controlled and hooks land firmly.

name: Hard-Hitting
prompt: Use forceful entrances punchy drums assertive phrasing and decisive hook impact without constant shouting.

name: Explosive
prompt: Create sudden high-contrast bursts of vocal and drum energy especially at hooks drops and final payoffs.

name: Relentless
prompt: Sustain intense forward pressure with hard articulation dense drum impact and almost no soft release.

name: Breakdown Peak
prompt: Keep earlier sections controlled then concentrate the strongest vocal drum and lyrical aggression in the breakdown.

name: Dynamic Swells
prompt: Alternate restrained passages with rising waves of force so each major peak feels larger than the last.
